name: ShareCrashData
description: Share Crash Data with FPP Developers
tip: Create a crash report if fppd crashes, and send it to the FPP developers.  'Keep locally' still writes a full report to the crashes folder so you can look at it or submit it yourself, but sends nothing; 'Disabled' does not write one at all.  'Send stack traces only' sends the crash stack, the fault registers, the playlist position, the list of installed plugins and - if you gave one - the contact email address below, so we can ask you about it; it does not send this device's name, network addresses or settings.  The other options add settings and configuration files that help reproduce the problem; passwords, Wi-Fi passphrases, e-mail addresses and location are removed, and the network interface configuration is never included.
